name: Computer Vision Question Pack v1
description: Eighty original computer-vision certification items covering image representation, convolutional architectures, training, evaluation, detection, segmentation, projective geometry, robustness, and deployment.

provenance.chainOfTitle: Every question, option, answer, and explanation was newly authored for Octamy by Kiro AI under the authenticated product owner's instruction. Official PyTorch and Torchvision documentation, OpenCV documentation, and NIST adversarial machine-learning guidance were used only as factual evidence; no proprietary examination or third-party question-bank wording was copied.
provenance.notes: The governed decisions explicitly identify Kiro AI review and do not claim human review.
